Facial Swelling or Dental Infection – may indicate a spreading infection that needs prompt attention
Severe Tooth Pain – persistent or sharp pain often signals an underlying dental problem
Broken or Damaged Teeth – proper evaluation helps determine the safest treatment path
Jaw Pain or Difficulty Opening the Mouth – may point to TMJ concerns requiring professional care
Missing Teeth and Need for Dental Implants – early consultation supports better implant planning

items.question: What does an Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon do?
items.answer: An oral and maxillofacial surgeon treats complex dental, oral, jaw, and facial conditions, including wisdom teeth, tooth extractions, implants, oral infections, jaw pain, and dental injuries.

items.question: When should I search for an Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon near me?
